snippet.title: Madagascar - Nintendo DS Longplay [HD]
snippet.description:
Name: Madagascar

Description: Based on the animated film from DreamWorks, Madagascar tells the tale of four animals in New York's Central Park Zoo. You must use the skills of your animal crew (consisting of a lion, zebra, giraffe, and hippo) to overcome a variety of dangerous obstacles.

Release Date: May 2005
